batting.dismissal: c R Sharma b AC Thomas

batting.dismissal: c Harpreet Singh b JE Taylor

batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b J Syed Mohammad

batting.name: TD Paine
batting.dismissal: c DL Vettori b S Aravind

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b DL Vettori

balls.text: dropped by Kamran, who seemingly can't do anything right, it was swiped by Kaif towards deep midwicket, it a not too easy a chance, but Kamran gets there and shells it, superb finish from Taylor, just six off the final over
slower offcutter from Taylor, 122kmh, shortish and outside off, Kaif was through with the shot too early, this is turning out to be a great final over from Taylor
short of length ball outside off, Tiwary wants to hammer the ball over midwicket, gets an outside edge towards deep backward point, taken by Harpreet, end of Tiwary's cameo
Tiwary looks to club that length delivery out of the ground, doesn't get any bat on it, Taylor escapes, that's not the length to be bowling at this stage
full ball, wide this time, Tiwary can't only jab it towards long-off, Kaif is quick between the stumps, he pushes Tiwary into returning for the second
superb delivery to start, 140.5 kmh yorker on offstump, somehow Tiwary makes room and squeezes the ball towards deep backward point
overpitched by Thomas, Kaif bludgeons it back past the bowler for four, take that you critics he doesn't say
superb from Thomas, short of length and outside off, Kaif throws his bat at it and can't connect
length ball is flat-batted by Kaif, not too well timed by him, lobs between mid-on and mid-off

Kohli's gone this time, Thomas has been superbly today, Kohli wanted to help length ball over deep midwicket, Harpreet Singh latches on to that one, to the relief of Thomas, end of an outstanding innings from Kohli
length ball outside off, scythed towards wide long-on for two more
full ball just outside off, whipped towards midwicket for a couple, superbly run by the two youngsters, Harpreet couldn't pick that up cleanly

oh man, that is the definition of power, Taylor's attempted yorker is a touch short of the blockhole, that's enough for Tiwary to muscle the ball straight back for four, just missing the stumps at the non-striker's end
slower ball from Taylor, 117kmh, on legstump, giving Tiwary no room at all, Tiwary defends down the track
Tiwary joins the party, a brutal hit from Tiwary, stands tall and swings as hard as he can to send the ball over wide long-on for six
slapped to the leg side for a single
whoah, even mishits flying for, Kohli looked to launch this one over long-on, gets a thick outside edge and the ball sails over third man for six, Kohli is in some form here
Kohli is unstoppable! a full ball on the pads is slammed over deep backward square leg, fast hands this from Kohli, and a man in the crowd catches that on the second attempt, well done sir
Taylor starts the over with a wide down the leg side
Tiwary wants to pull his first delivery, a short ball on legstump, he can't get bat on it and is struck on the shoulder
on the pads, tucked towards midwicket for a single which brings up the half-century
end of AB de Villiers, and not the kind of delivery that usually gets a wicket, a hit-me full toss which de Villiers hits but not far enough, long-on is waiting
in the blockhole from Thomas, not much Kohli can do with that, he digs it out towards square leg
lashed towards extra cover for a single
classy from AB, a length ball just outside off, Ab makes a bit of room and opesn the face to steer the ball to the third man boundary
a quiet end to the over, driven along the ground towards extra cover for a single
what a sight that is, de Villiers breaks the 100m barrier with a murderous hit over long-on, nearly on to the roof, a fullish ball from Ryder, nice and gentle pace, dismissed by de Villiers
opens the face and wants to run it past short third man, not enough pace on the ball, and only gets a single
way outside off stump, Kohli leaves it alone
Kohli on fire here, another beautiful drive for four, this time through cover, just a bit of width there, and Kohli latches on to it to bring up the 50 stand
drilled to long-on, overpitched ball and Kohli timed that brilliantly, Pandey doives at the boundary but can't cut it off
that final over has damaged Rahul's figures a bit, he ends with 4-0-27-2 as the last ball is slapped towards backward point
a quicker one from Rahul, Kohli brings out the pull, hammers the ball past cow corner for four more
Kohli loves hammering the ball over long-off, an inside-out lofted hit gets him another six, a touch straighter than he wanted but he got plenty of power on that one
de Villiers sashays down the track, all for a single, on the pads and de Villiers punches it to long-on
once again worked towards point
batsman backs away and sends the ball towards deep point as Rahul returns for his final over
length ball outside off, pushed to cover and the batsmen zip through for a single, Ryder slips in a tidy over
a low full toss outside off, whipped towards wide long-on by Kohli
length ball, batsman gets forward and defends it towards extra cover
fired down the leg side, hit Kohli on the back leg I think, umpire first signals wide and then gives it off the bat
length ball outside off, batsman can't connect as he looks to power it through cover
length ball heading for leg, played inside-out towards cover, a dot ball to end the over
the hundred comes up with a slap towards point for a single
these not going for the big hits, de Villiers gets forward and drops the ball towards cover for a single
short of length ball pitching just outside off, whipped towards wide mid-on
throws this one up, de Villiers gets forward and dabs the ball to the off side for a single
overpitched outside off, caressed towards sweeper cover by de Villiers
ends the over by giving away a single, short of length and outside off, carved towards sweeper cover, Taylor fields
fullish ball, defended to the off side, a dot ball for Kamran
slower legcutter from Kamran, stabbed towards backward point off the back foot
shortish ball, 143.3kmh this time, de Villiers stands tall and glides the ball towards third man
slips in the slower one, 115kmh, full delivery, dabbed towards the off side for a single
smashed! a length ball is pummeled over long-on for six by Kohli, Kamran's day just got worse
drops it short, not much turn after pitching on off, eased towards extra cover
length ball on off, de Villiers pushes it to cover from the crease
lovely stroke for a single, a length ball outside off, lofted off drive bounces to long-off
length ball pitching on middle, tucked off the back foot towards midwicket
overpitched outside off, Kohli moves towards leg and swings the ball over point, Paine does the fielding
length ball outside off, poked towards point for a single
well outside off, guided towards deep backward point for a single
overpitched ball, Kohli doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball, he hoicks it towards long-on
de Villiers gets off the mark by working the ball to leg
pushed towards mid-off for a single
outside off, Kohli throws his bat at it and misses
another effortful stroke from Kohli, backing away and crashing the ball to cover

Sharma doing the job for Pune, he's got another big wicket now, Yuvraj has a big grin on his face, a length ball pitching on middle and strikes Gayle on the pads as he is stuck on the crease, it might have been a bit too high but the umpire was satisfied, no half-century for Gayle
once more Gayle is troubled by the turn, it spins into him off a length, gets an inside-edge after he skips away past leg, races away past the keeper for four
powered towards cover, inside-out shot for a single
an inside-edge takes the ball past the keeper for a single

nearly a run-out, Kohli delicately dabs the ball  towards short third man, sprints the single, he would have been well short if there had been a direct hit from Taylor, Taylor misses, and Kohli crashes into the bowler, Kohli has a sore shoulder, Sharma was hit in the back
just outside off, dabbed past backward point by Gayle, a misfield allows an extra run
punches this one towards long-on for a single
gets forward and defends back to the bowler
Kohli loves playing the ball towards extra cover, this was short and a touch wide and Kohli capitalised
length ball outside off, just enough room for Gayle to power the ball towards deep point
a lot of effort for a single, Kohli swings the ball towards deep midwicket
no maiden for Sharma as Kohli eases the final ball of the over towards mid-off and jogs a single
Sharma continues a great over,  a loopy full delivery, around offstump, defended by Kohli
take a bow Sharma, he's got the breakthrough, Dilshan continues to hunt for the ball without success, it zips through quicker and goes straight on, beats the bat and finds the middle stump
once more, another attempted cut flies over the top edge, Dilshan is disappointed at missing out
Dilshan backs away and looks to carve that over point but can't connect
starts with a length ball outside off, defended to the leg side
the full toss and he gets away with it, Gayle whips it to short fine leg, a few yards either side and that was racing away for four
what a shot from Gayle, he can do no wrong here, an overpitched ball outside off, Gayle sends this one soaring over the backward point and into the stands, Kamran 1.5-0-37-0, yikes!
Save Kamran Khan, Gayle is slamming him around, short of length and outside off, Gayle gets forward and hammers that over long-on, the fifty comes up
138.2 kmh from Kamran, doesn't help him as Gayle swings him to the midwicket boundary, not off the middle of the bat but enough power behind it
swish and a miss, shortish and outside off, connects only with air, murderous intent there from Gayle
a full ball, worked towards wide mid-on for a single
fires it outside off, and on a length, Gayle was backing away from legstump, he can't get bat on ball, superb from Thomas
whacks it towards deep midwicket this time, just a single, quiet over this so far
the slower one from Thomas, Gayle was charging out, he swiped it forcefully towards long-on, there's a fielder waiting, he takes it on the bounce
Thomas keeps it full, punched towards mid-off by Dilshan
short of length ball outside off, Dilshan was through with the pull too early, he's hit on the right arm
overpitched outside off, mistimed towards cover by Dilshan

a mix-up, but there's no run-out, Taylor responded to that dismissive shot from Dilshan with an accurate yorker, Dilshan squeezed it towards mid-on and set off for the run, Gayle wasn't responding initially, he does later and they are through safely for a single
smoked for a boundary, Dilshan anticipating that short one, powerfully and stylishly pulled for four by him, Bangalore in top gear here
slower ball, an offcutter, Gayle had to wait for that one to reach him, he adjusts his stroke and bunts the ball towards mid-on
neatly done, on the pads and Dilshan glances it down to fine leg

another short ball, Dilshan brings out the pull, top-edges and the ball goes up a mile, doesn't have the distance, spends an age in the air, Rahul Sharma sprints across from fine leg but the ball lands just wide of him
short ball outside off, Dilshan goes for the cut and misses
Gayle's in the mood here, once more he get a stride in and swats a short of length ball outside off, doesn't get hold of it as well as the previous ball, lands just short of the cover boundary
bang! Gayle is not surprised by that short ball at all, he gets forward and absolutely murders that one over long-on, a 97m six
slips in the bouncer, Gayle looks for the pull but doesn't go for the shot
this time he has snet it into orbit, not much footwork, just gets a little forward and golf-swings the ball over long-off for six
Gayle wants to sends that one into orbit, doesn't connect

welcomed with a boundary, a short of length ball outside off, Gayle dances down and scythes the ball past extra cover, where Yuvraj Singh decides against diving when he moight have had a chance of stopping the ball
good over from Taylor, ends it with a sharp bouncer outside off, Dilshan lets it go, four dot balls after that boundary
this one doesn't move away, holds its line, on offstump, defended
Taylor keeps it around 140kmh, Dilshan beaten outside off once more as Taylor gets the ball to curve away off the seam, past the outside edge once more
good response from Taylor, similar length and the ball jags away from Dilshan who is left fiddling outside off, beaten
cranks it up to 140kmh this time, a short of length ball outside off, Dilshan gets forward and carves that through the covers for four, nice way to get off the mark
starts with a loosener on middle and stump, worked towards square leg for a single
slower ball to end the over, 105kmh when he has operated around 130kmh previously, bit of width and Gayle slaps it behind point for a single
keeps it short of a length and angles it away from Gayle, who skates out of the crease and looks to smash the ball to long-on but misses
Bangalore are away, a short ball on legstump, Gayle is surprised by that one but he manages to help it to fine leg
full ball on middle and off, blocked from the crease by Gayle
just outside off, Gayle wants to flat bat that down the ground, gets a bottom edge and the ball rolls to the bowler
good ball to start, on a length and curves in to Gayle, who defends off the front foot

Bangalore celebrate, Pune slump to their fifth straight defeat, their time at the top of the table seems a very very long time ago, the final ball was full and angling across Uthappa, who can't get bat on it
slower ball is lashed towards long-off
full ball on middle stump, punched to mid-off by Uthappa
finally, the Uthappa for whom the millions were splashed makes an appearance, a nonchalant swipe sends the length ball over the midwicket boundary
another boundary to fine leg for Uthappa, a length ball is helped along with the angle for four more
slower and full, well outside off, called a wide, Aravind can't believe the call
slower ball to start the over, Uthappa gets it away to fine leg, not too convincing
a fantastic over from Gayle kills off the game, he's seems happy with it, the final ball is sent to short fine for a single
fired in full again by Gayle, quicker, Uthappa pushes it towards mid-off
a yorker on middle and leg, punched back towards the bowler
Manhas is gone, a length ball that Manhas can't get the power behind, he tries to smash the ball over long-on, only find Kaif
whacked towards fine leg this time
fullish on middle, swiped towards midwicket, can't beat the fielder
Vettori completes an outstanding over, for the third time in the over Mithun does the fielding, dot ball
Uthappa swipes towards wide long-on this time
once again the cut, once again Mithun fields, no run this time
Bangalore's fielding once again is good, Manhas carves the ball to backward point, where Mithun throws himself to his left to field
driven to the bowler's left, Vettori is across quickly to cut that off
length ball is clubbed down to long-on for a single
Manhas gets off the mark by jabbing the ball to point for a couple
Zak has done the job, a length ball that Yuvraj wanted to smash out of the park, hit on the splice of the bat and the ball swirls to Syed for an easy catch,  end of Pune's challenge?
Zak fires it in full, outside off, lashes it towards wide long-off, where Kaif does the fielding
Uthappa attempts an innovative whip over fine leg after moving across the stumps, off the thigh pad and over the keeper
cross-batted it towards midwicket, where a dive from Syed keeps the batsmen to a single, Bangalore's fielding has been sharp today
full and just outside off, narrowly missing the stumps
nicely bowled by Syed, full delivery on middle, Yuvraj can only dig that out towards mid-off
short of length and outside off, nudged to the leg side to get back Yuvraj on strike
fired in full and fast, just outside off, Yuvraj can't get under it
Yuvraj Singh looking unstoppable here, this was a dreadful ball from Syed, very short and wide, swiped over midwicket for the 300th six of the tournament
this time he drags it short, Yuvraj mows that for a one-bounce for to midwicket
Shot! Yuvraj Singh is in a murderous mood here, first ball of the over is hammered over the bowler's head for six, powerful hit that
a boundary to make it seven off the over, slides it down leg, easy for Uthappa who whips the ball past short fine leg
Mithun greets his Karnataka team-mate with a 142 kmh bouncer, Uthappa ducks under that one
carved towards sweeper cover, short of length and outside off from Mithun, just a single
this is shorter from Mithun and just outside off, Yuvraj makes room and tries to tap the ball towards point, again Yuvraj can't get bat on ball
length ball from Mithun, Yuvraj's eye light up but he can't punish it, a cross-batted attempted mow misses, and the ball zips through to the keeper
swiped towards deep midwicket by Yuvraj
Pandey's troubled stay is over, he takes on long-off and loses, Tiwary doesn't have to move as the ball comes straight to him
Yuvraj survives, another mishit goes to no man's land, this time his attempt to clear long-on just about clears the inner circle
length ball outside off, another mistimed, ugly flat-batted hit from Pandey sends the ball rolling past the bowler
doesn't get hold of it as he sweeps the ball towards midwicket
Yuvraj is making a match of this, a length ball turning in towards Yuvraj, a swing of the bat sends the ball sailing over long-on for six
a low full toss on legstump, tucked towards midwicket
length ball, follows Yuvraj who was skipping past leg, Yuvraj gets an inside-edge towards deep backward square leg
fuller ball on offstump, blocked by Yuvraj
superb hit from Yuvraj, placement was great, it was a short of length ball from Zaheer, Yuvraj sashays down the track and slams the ball on-the-up to wide long-off
'Two, two' is the call from Yuvraj as soon as he whipped the ball to wide long-on
Yuvraj has an everything-must-go mindset here, attempts to powerfully pull a short ball from Zaheer but can't connect
Yuvraj looks to loft his first ball for six, can't get the distance and ends up bisecting long-on and long-off

nicely done by Pandey, he's not been too fluent today, but this was a clever shot, full and outside leg, Pandey gets on one knee and helps the ball wide past short fine for four, not a great ball that from Syed
bowled from wide of the crease, length ball just outside off, hurries on to Pandey, who can't connect well with the swipe once more
darted into the pads, Pandey can't get it away, off the pads towards the leg side
the end of Ryder, Syed strikes, the big runs were needed, Ryder tried to get that by clearing midwicket, he doesn't get hold of the ball, Mohammad Kaif lies it wait at the midwicket boundary
Pandey's troubles continues, he tries to swing the ball to midwicket, botom-edges it past the keeper
fired down the leg side, past the pads for a wide
full ball to start from Syed, Ryder whips it to midwicket for a single
off the thigh pad towards fine leg
whips another short ball down to fine leg, this time he does beat the fielder, gets four to bring up his half-century
extra bounce from Mithun, beats Ryder outside off
that's more of what Pune need, Ryder raises the front leg as he swivels and pulls a shortish ball for six over square leg
horribly mistimed by Pandey, who is looking badly out of touch, a shortish ball is flat batted past the bowler
Pune just can't find the boundary, short ball on legstump, Ryder had scuttled across,can't place it fine enough to beat fine leg
full and just outside off, punched to mid-off
carved towards sweeper cover for a single, superb over from Vettori
gets on one knee and powers that one to midwicket, Gayle fields that one well, just a single off the over so far, what are Pune doing?
once more Pandey makes room and chops the ball but can't beat Dilshan at backward point
short of length and outside off, Pandey dabs the ball towards point, there's confusion whether to take a run, Pandey dives back to make his ground
length ball fired in towards leg, tapped towards mid-on
innovative from Ryder, jumps across the stumps and tips a legstump ball fine, couldn't beat the man at short fine though
punched down the ground for a single
another low full toss, Ryder can't get it past extra cover
a low full toss on offstump, thumped towards mid-off
on the pads, tapped towards midwicket, Kohli charges in and fires in the throw to keep the batsmen to a single
fired in full, on legstump, Ryder skips away and works the ball to sweeper cover, and steals a couple
dabbed towards cover by Pandey
'Catch,' was the desperate cry from Vettori as Ryder carved the ball towards deep point
chopped towards point for a single
Pandey gets Pune a much-needed boundary, he slugs the ball towards deep midwicket, where Syed dives to get a hand on the ball but can't stop it from trickling over
Ryder tucks this off his pads towards square leg
Vettori starts with a short ball, it turns away a touch, Pandey plays it back to the bowler
Pandey wants to scythe this over through the covers, gets a thick edge and the ball flies towards sweeper cover
length ball on offstump, Ryder shuffles across and whips the ball to deep backward square leg
short ball, pulled by Pandey, loops towards deep midwicket, reaches the fielder on the bouncer
139kmh delivery outside off, jags away a touch to beat the outside edge of Pandey's bat, looking to drive that one through off
shorter this time, on middle and off, Pandey pokes the ball towards point, Rydere wants one, Pandey doesn't, Ryder has to turn back, scramble and dive to get back
length ball speared into off, defended back down the pitch
length ball on middle,. Ryder comes down the track and taps the ball back to the bowler, there was no room for him to swing the arms there
length ball outside off, Ryder looking to drive through the off, gets the outside edge wide enough to beat the keeper and fine enough to beat short third man, four more
a big swipe from Ryder, no contact and the ball sails harmlessly past the offstump
length ball outside off, Ryder slaps the ball towards cover
length ball on the pads, nudged behind square leg
Paine's torture is over, he swings a short ball to short fine leg, it was just over waist high on legstump, Paine could have slammed that anywhere on the leg side, instead he picks out short fine
a good over from Mithun to start, Paine looks to work the ball to the leg side, off the body towards cover
on legstump, whipped towards Gayle at midwicket, a direct hit would have made it interesting as the batsmen scrambled a single
Mithun keeps it short of length, just outside off, dabbed towards backward point
horribly mistimed, Piane looks to smash a shortish ball through off, the ball bounces several times before it reaches mid-off
shortish on legstump, a short arm jab sends the ball to deep backward square leg
starts with a short ball outside off, again the batsman bottom-edges the ball towards the bowler
well outside off, shortish again, Ryder skips towards leg and looks to flatbat the ball, bottom edges it towards the bowler
moves across the stumps, cramped by the middle and leg line, that was short of length, defended to square leg
Aravind falls over after delivering the ball, which Ryder defends to the bowler's left and ambles a single
length ball on middle and leg, whipped towards mid-on where Mithun makes a diving stop
short of length ball that Paine wanted to smash to deep midwicket, he misses, keeper thinks there was a bottom edge, umpire doesn't
short of length ball flies over the top of middle stump as Paine backs away and looks to slap the ball to point
length ball angling across, Paine guides the ball towards third man for a single to end the over
worked towards the leg side for a single
Ryder is timing is brilliantly here, this time he hoicks a shortish ball from Zak over long-on for four
on legstump this time, helped along to fine leg, where a sharp bit of fielding keeps the ball from bounding over the boundary
lovely delivery from Zak, jags away after pitching just outside off, Ryder is beaten
outside edges flying for six here, short of length ball curves away from Ryder, who wanted to send the ball flying over long-on, thick outside edge flies over third man
whacked towards wide mid-on for a single
poor delivery from Aravind, sliding down the leg side, easily helped past short fine leg for four
fullish and on offstump, punched back to the bowler
short of length ball on middle, whipped towards square leg
length ball on middle and leg, mistimed back towards the bowler
on target this time, a length ball on middle, defended down the track
again he sprays it much too far outside off
Aravind starts with a wide outside off
short of length ball on the legstump, Paine waltzes down the track, hit on the thigh pad, the ball rolls to square leg
short of length ball jags away from the outside edge, Paine prods at it and misses
starts outside off and carries on further with the angle, too far away from the stumps
short of length ball outside off, jabbed towards deep backward point
on the pads, seams in a touch, helped towards fine leg
that looked like a textbook off drive, except he except Paine couldn't get bat on it
Zak starts with a fullish ball outside off, pushed towards extra cover
